Name: Self-Curse
Casting Time: 1 reaction to failing a saving throw
Components: V, S, M (a small blade capable of penetrating your skin)
Description: You may exchange your own blood and wellbeing for a brief increase to your abilities. You succeed on a saving throw that you would otherwise fail, but in exchange take 1d6 points of irreducible damage multiplied by the difference between your failed save result and the DC it failed to beat.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher, you can reduce the damage you take from this spell by 5 points for each slot level above 1st.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
